StringWithMarkup.String: Mevinphos is a dialkyl phosphate and an organophosphate insecticide. It has a role as an acaricide, an agrochemical, an avicide and an EC 3.1.1.7 (acetylcholinesterase) inhibitor. It is functionally related to a methyl 3-hydroxybut-2-enoate.

Mevinphos is an organophosphate insecticide that acts as an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor to control insects in a wide range of crops. It is most commonly used for the control of chewing and sucking insects, as well as spider mites.
